title: The Harlem Globetrotters: Rivalry Tour
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour to Springfield, where they face the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals, and fans can help decide the action, get pulled onto the court, and take over the jumbotron. A free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM, and the event is for all ages. It takes place Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena; parking is $20, or $50 for premium.

organizer.name: Great Southern Bank Arena, Missouri State University
